faq.q1: Where can I buy submarine parts in FFXIV?
faq.a1: You can buy premium FFXIV submarine parts from Alamai Submarines at submarines.alamai.dev. We offer all submarine components including hulls, sterns, bows, and bridges with live stock levels and instant ordering.
faq.q2: How do I make money with crafting in FF14?
faq.a2: One of the best ways to make gil with crafting in FF14 is by crafting submarine parts for other players. Submarine parts are always in demand because Free Companies need them for submarine voyages. Alamai Submarines connects crafters with buyers through our For Crafters program.
faq.q3: What are the best submarine builds in FFXIV?
faq.a3: Popular submarine builds in FFXIV include WSUC (Whale-class) and SSSS (Shark-class) configurations. Use our Set Builder tool at submarines.alamai.dev to compare different part combinations, see stats, and calculate total costs for your ideal submarine build.
faq.q4: What is a submarine set builder for FF14?
faq.a4: A submarine set builder is a tool that lets you pick individual submarine parts (hull, stern, bow, bridge) and see the total stats, price, and availability. Alamai Submarines offers a free set builder with live pricing and stock levels.
